content.short: Marginly provides a margin trading engine with a liquidity-aggregating router across multiple DEXs.
content.description: Marginly brings together a margin trading engine for leveraged position management—enabling opening, adjusting leverage, and closing positions—with a smart router that aggregates liquidity from multiple DEXs to facilitate trading of long-tail assets. Through this design, Marginly enables users to take up to 20x leveraged long or short positions on crypto assets across DEXs such as Uniswap, Trader Joe, KyberSwap, DODO, Balancer, and other platforms, consolidating diverse liquidity into a single trading experience.
